content:
flowchart TB
    subgraph SIG[Signals]
        S1[S1 Retrieval]
        S2[S2 Generation]
        S3[S3 Consistency]
        S4[S4 Src agree]
        S5[S5 Entities]
    end

    WC[Weighted sum]
    PS[Platt scale]
    CC([Calibrated p])

    S1 --> WC
    S2 --> WC
    S3 --> WC
    S4 --> WC
    S5 --> WC
    WC --> PS --> CC

    subgraph HAL[NLI path]
        ANS[Answer]
        DOC[Docs]
        HD[DeBERTa NLI]
        HF([Contradict flag])
    end

    ANS --> HD
    DOC --> HD
    HD --> HF

    style CC fill:#27AE60,color:#fff,stroke:#2c3e50
    style HF fill:#E74C3C,color:#fff,stroke:#2c3e50
    style PS fill:#8E44AD,color:#fff,stroke:#2c3e50
    style WC fill:#2980B9,color:#fff,stroke:#2c3e50
    style SIG fill:#F8F9FA,stroke:#34495e
